title: Restore completed conversation turns (Experimental)
goal: Recreate an observatory conversation view from completed local text turns, explicitly restore the experimental agent history and continue without replaying stored turns as new writes.

selectionNotes: SDK11.0.100/ASP.NET11.0.0 and Components.AI 0.1.0-preview.1.26466.103: real Interactive Server rendering and ProtectedSessionStorage in Chromium. Completed-turn persistence, reload/recreate/restore/continue, ordering, replay duplicate prevention, canceled/disposed turn exclusion and storage failure/retry exercised. Scripted text client only; no remote conversation/run durability, host restart durability, WASM/Hybrid or model proof. PIN-967 remains open.

constraints: Experimental Components.AI has only a net11.0 asset. The newer 0.1.0-preview.1.26466.103 exposes thread/restore APIs absent from the historical preview-7 audit; actual compilation confirms signatures, not runtime behaviour.

Local browser-tab session storage, text-only completed turns and one active component owner are the bounded design. Host-process restart, key persistence, quota/tampering recovery, arbitrary tool/media/state serialization and multiple concurrent writers are not implemented guarantees.

ThreadId identifies this application thread; IsStateful=false and ConversationId=null do not invent remote provider state. No remote model, provider conversation, AG-UI run/thread ID or resume behaviour is exercised.
All five available sample builds are compilation only; no browser storage or framework restoration was executed. The scripted client is explicitly not a model.
